title: Ali ki mad'ha karta hu'n
body:
Ali ki mad'ha karta hu'n yahi ek kaam baaqi hai
isi ki waj'ha se dunya me mera naam baaqi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
zamee'n jab tak hai jab tak charq neeli faam baaqi hai
fiza me fatima ki jaan ka paighaam baaqi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ali ke saath haq hai aur ali bhi saath hai haq ke
Khuda ka naam jab tak hai Ali ka naam baqi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hazaaaro'n ke gale kaate ali ne tegh se lekin
Abhi bache ki turbat khodne ka kaam baaqi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
supurde qaak karna hai abhi zindaa'n me bachi ko
Ilaahi ghamzada zainab ka ye bhi kaam baaqi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ali e murtaza aaye na teri zindagi me gar
sa'eed itna na ghabra naz'a ka hungaam baaqi hai
